Fitzpatrick I: very fair, blue/green eyes, always burns, never tans — 5–8 min at UV5
Fitzpatrick II: fair, burns easily, tans minimally — 8–12 min at UV5
Fitzpatrick III: medium, sometimes burns, gradually tans — 12–20 min at UV5
Fitzpatrick IV: olive, rarely burns, tans easily — 20–30 min at UV5
Fitzpatrick V: brown, very rarely burns, tans very easily — 30–45 min at UV5
Fitzpatrick VI: deeply pigmented, never burns — 45–60 min at UV5
